key_rationale: While headline CPI at 5.02% shows moderation, the food inflation spike to 6.56% and a positive output gap of 0.70% necessitate continued vigilance to prevent the unanchoring of inflation expectations. Maintaining the current repo rate of 6.50% and the stance of withdrawal of accommodation is essential to ensure that monetary transmission remains effective and that liquidity conditions stay aligned with our objective of durably aligning inflation to the 4.00% target.
